answer: By binding each identity to a ferrous hardware root whose NTP-timestamped attestations must advance monotonically, the protocol turns the tide of fake registrations into a detectable causal-ordering violation. A comet-like burst of new peers within one epoch window triggers Byzantine skew-bound checks, since honest clocks drift far less than that sudden arrival density. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
